Summary: As a system architect, I want a 3NF normalized SQLite schema with foreign key constraints so that data integrity is guaranteed.
Description: Implement database.py with 5 relational entities: users, patients, doctors, departments, appointments. Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON.

Summary: As a user, I want secure authentication with PBKDF2 password hashing and role-based access control (Admin, Doctor, Patient).
Description: Enforce secure password hashing using PBKDF2-SHA256. Implement @role_required route decorator in auth.py.

Summary: As a patient, I want to register with my clinical vitals (blood group, DOB, phone, address) to create a medical profile.
Description: Build patient self-registration with blood group, date of birth, emergency contact, and address validation.

Summary: As a frontend developer, I want a responsive healthcare design system with modern CSS and reusable component templates.
Description: Develop healthcare design system in styles.css with responsive clinical header, navigation bar, and accessible contrast tokens.

Summary: As a patient, I want to browse doctors by specialty and pick available time slots with zero double-booking conflict.
Description: Dynamic asynchronous slot generation in patient.py with SQL compound constraint UNIQUE(doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, status).

Summary: As a doctor, I want an outpatient queue where I can record clinical diagnosis notes and generate digital prescriptions.
Description: Doctor consultation portal in doctor.py with consultation suite, clinical diagnosis recording, and prescription issuing.

Summary: As a hospital admin, I want a master oversight console to manage doctor rosters, view patients, and override appointment statuses.
Description: Admin console in admin.py with hospital statistics, doctor onboarding form, patient audit registry, and appointment status override.

Summary: As a QA engineer, I must build an automated unit and integration test suite with 100% pass rate.
Description: Author 17 automated tests in tests/test_app.py and test_ui_workflow.py covering positive, negative, and boundary scenarios.

Summary: As a patient, I want automated SMS and email reminders 24 hours prior to my consultation.
Description: Integration of SMS gateway (Twilio/Twilio API) and SMTP email dispatcher for appointment notifications.

Summary: As a patient and doctor, I want integrated WebRTC video calling for remote telemedicine consultations.
Description: Real-time audio-video consultation room using WebRTC peer connections and signaling server.

Summary: As an administrator, I want an integrated payment gateway (Razorpay/Stripe) to process upfront clinic consultation fees.
Description: Secure payment checkout integration for doctor consultation fee transactions prior to slot confirmation.
